== Editing ==
English Decipher-era comparison for [[Tatooine: Lars' Moisture Farm]]. One column per published text state, in date order: the Premiere Limited card, the Premiere Unlimited card (the first printing without Owen Lars), Decipher's Glossary errata, and each Players Committee image. The Premiere Two-Player card ([[Tatooine: Lars' Moisture Farm (Two-Player)]]) prints the Limited words and is not a column. The stamp row describes the mark on each image. Yellow highlights mark the words that changed between neighbouring columns; the Glossary's en dash in “–1” is typesetting, not a change. Use explicit <code>1=</code> for <code><nowiki>{{Errata hl}}</nowiki></code> arguments.
